badoptimizations:
BadOptimizations
A collection of mostly micro optimizations that add up to something bigger!

 What does it do?
Multiple things: 

- Avoid updating lightmap 
 Updating lightmap textures are one of the most expensive parts of the client tick. During each tick, the client will do vector math to calculate lightmaps for blocks and the sky, then upload that new texture to the GPU. However, this can be completely avoided and cached if nothing affecting block brightness has changed. This mod will cancel lightmap updates if nothing that changes block brightness (e.g. gamma slider, potion effects, dimension) has changed. 
- Don't do debug logic if we don't need to

- Rain on glass

- Rain on lava / magma

- Plains Village

- Savanna Village
- Snowy Village

ABOUT

Create: Prismatic Shine is a remake mod for Create: Crystal Clear. It adds glass casings, glass scaffold and illumination casings to create. 

This mod was created because Create: Crystal Clear has not been updated for a long time, preventing players from enjoying glass casings in NeoForge 1.21.1 and Create 6.0. Additionally, this mod builds upon Create: Crystal Clear by adding illumination casings - a type of glass casing that emits light. 

Furthermore, we have modified some recipes to make this mod more aligned with vanilla Create. For example, you can now right-click on glass with Andesite Alloy to craft Andesite Glass Casing, which can then be processed into Andesite Clear Glass Casing using a Stonecutter or Mechanical Saw. No Hostiles Around Campfire prevents hostile mobs from spawning around campfires, by default in a radius of 48 blocks. When a player places a campfire, hostile mobs nearby are set on fire for 30 seconds. Breaking that campfire puts them out again. Mobs with a custom name are left alone, so your name tagged zombie is safe. It blocks natural spawns, pillager patrols, zombie sieges and zombified piglins coming out of nether portals. Spawn eggs, commands and raids are never blocked, and mob spawners only if enabled in the config. Modded hostile mobs are supported as well. Campfires can be required to be lit, signalling or under open sky, and normal and soul campfires can be toggled separately. Campfires added by other mods work as well. Specific mobs can be ignored, or treated as hostile when their mod doesn't register them as one. You may also be interested in Healing Campfire .

- 挖掘掉落物不再会被新方块挤开

Lyingice's Spear Library · 长矛公共库

 本作者长矛模组共用的底层库：把矛的移动判定、命中检测、蓄力阶段与生物 AI 抽出来，供各版本的长矛模组复用。 
 整合包作者可以不写一行 Java —— 用 KubeJS 脚本就能注册一把真正的矛。 

 中文在前，English below.

 KubeJS：用脚本加自己的矛（重点）

 不写 Java、不改模组本体 ，五行脚本就是一把真矛：

 js
StartupEvents.registry('item', event = {
 event.create('mypack:bronze spear', 'spearcore:spear')
 .displayName('青铜矛')
 .durability(400)
 .attackDamageBonus(3)
 .texture('mypack:item/bronze spear')
})
 

- 第二参数 'spearcore:spear' 是物品类型，写了它才会用本库的矛类创建。
- 所有参数都能在脚本里调 ：耐久、攻击力、冲锋伤害系数、攻速、附魔能力、四段蓄力时长、攻击距离、判定箱、冲锋推力、击退、击落骑手、怪物距离倍率、音效……不写就沿用铁矛的数值。
- 造出来的是 真矛 ：戳刺、冲锋、第一/第三人称动作、附魔、怪物 AI 一视同仁，不用再配任何东西。
- 脚本没生效时本库照常运行，不会报错、也不会加载任何相关代码。
- KubeJS 版本：1.21.1 用 2101.x，1.20.1 用 2001.x。
- 完整参数表、贴图规范与常见坑见仓库里的 kjs-guide.md （中英双语）。

 其余提供什么

- 长矛基类 ：继承即可拥有戳刺、蓄力冲锋，以及多段阶段窗口（起手 / 击落骑手 / 击退 / 伤害）。
- 速度判定接口 ：自定义生物实现 UseSpearSpecialEntity 就能接入同一套"移动越快伤害越高"的规则，所需速度、攻击距离、伤害倍率都可调。
- 命中与击退工具 ：沿视线方向的实体命中检测，以及命中后攻击

wynnlimbo:
WynnLimbo
Are you tired of sitting in a black box while queuing to join the prof world?

Do you want something to do while waiting? Then this is the mod for you!

When queuing for worlds, WynnLimbo will drop you onto a small island to explore and jump around on while waiting!

 

 How it works
When queuing for a world, wynncraft puts the client in state where it only has to spend minimal resources on it. In practice this means that no chunk data is sent to the client and that the server ignores almost all packets from the client. Here is where WynnLimbo comes in. It sends its own chunk and entity data for the client to load and therefore allows you to move around and explore the limbo.

 Credits
This mod was written by GoldenShadow.

The island was built by Barled, VireVeonix and GoldenShadow and inspired by builds on wynncraft.

AGRICRAFT

AgriCraft is a mod which aims to bring crop breeding to Minecraft, this includes both improving your existing crops, or cross-breeding to mutate into new species of crops.

The mod has been entirely rewritten for 1.16.5, so for both the apprentice and the expert, it might be opportune to give this a quick read.

 
Genetics
AgriCraft follows mendellian genetics, this means that the genome of a plant consists of a series of genes, where each gene appears as a pair of alleles.

Usually, one allele is dominant over the other, the latter being called recessive.

For instance if we consider gene "A", with dominant allele A and recessive allele a, the following holds:

 Gene Pair A-A: both dominant, A will be the apparant trait;
 Gene Pair: A-a: A is dominant over a, so A will be the apparent trait;
 Gene Pair: a-a: both recessive, so a will be the apparent trait.

AgriCraft contains

CC: Create Redstone Link

Based on . I would have simply contributed the additional feature of adding color support there, but unfortunately that mod is not source available (despite the MIT license on its page).

This mod connects Create Redstone Link networks with CC:Tweaked computers . It adds a single block, the CC Redstone Link Bridge , which can be placed in the world and then used as a ComputerCraft peripheral.

This mod requires Create and CC:Tweaked .

 What the Mod Does

The bridge acts as a small adapter between two systems:

- Create provides the Redstone Link network.
- CC:Tweaked provides Lua control from computers.

With the bridge block in the world, a connected computer can:

- read the current signal strength of any Redstone Link frequency pair
- send a signal strength to any Redstone Link frequency pair
- optionally tag either frequency slot with a 24-bit RGB dye color

optimizemod:
OptimizeMod

 Keep distant simulation quiet so active gameplay gets more CPU time.

OptimizeMod is a lightweight Fabric optimization mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 .
Its goal is simple: reduce work on entities and effects that players are not actively interacting with.

 What OptimizeMod changes

 1. Distance-based movement tick throttling ( EntityTickMixin )
Hook: LivingEntity.tickMovement() 

- Players are excluded.
- If no player is found within sleep distance ( 96 blocks by default), non-player living entities skip movement ticks ( ENTITY TICK SKIP = 4 by default).
- If a player is present but farther than reduce distance ( 48 blocks), movement updates are throttled (roughly every other tick).

 2. Distance-based AI throttling ( MobEntityAIMixin )
Hook: LivingEntity.tickNewAi() (for MobEntity )

graceful-packets:
Graceful Packets

 Description
A Fabric mod that prevents the client from disconnecting when it fails to decode a packet (common with ViaVersion bugs) from the server or encounters registry errors. 
Instead of disconnecting the entire client when a packet cannot be decoded, the mod simply ignores the problematic packet after logging the error to console, and continues running.
You can optionally also log it to chat, and change settings through the Mod Menu.

 Configuration

Under ./config/graceful-packets.conf 

 
suppress errors=true
log to chat=false
 
 suppress errors: When set to true (default), the mod will suppress packet decode and registry errors instead of disconnecting. Set to false to disable the mod.
 log to chat: When set to true , suppressed errors will also be displayed in the in-game chat. Default is false .

 More mods

- Anti-Exploit - A drop-in mod for preventing commo

KubeJS Hooks for Create Automation

KJSCAuto allows KubeJS scripts to modify key automation behaviors in Create.

This mod exposes several Create actions as script events so pack makers can intercept and modify them without writing Java mods.

Recipe modification is intentionally not included, as that functionality is already provided by KubeJS Create.

Currently supported hooks include:

 Deployer item/tool usage
 Basin recipe operations
 Block breaking by drills and saws
 Contraption disassembly

These events allow scripts to:

 adjust tool durability usage on Deployer
 modify Basin recipe inputs and outputs
 intercept or replace block drops when destroyed by machines or contraptions

These hooks were selected to address several common automation control issues I often see discussed in the KubeJS community.

 Configuration

 Beacon FOV changes 
 Soul Speed FOV changes

namereplace:
NameReplace
Will replace all instances of the player name in chat messages and the tablist with a custom replacement.

 Command overview:
A /namereplace command exists that allows you to add, remove, or clear player names from the replacement list. Requires permission level 3 by default, but it can be changed in the config.

- /namereplace add : Adds a name to replace. Will overwrite existing names.
- /namereplace remove : Removes a name from the override list.
- /namereplace list : Prints current name replace table
- /namereplace clear : Removes all name overrides.

By default, there is also a /replacename command alias registered that redirects to the normal command. It can be disabled in the config.

 Things of note:
- Nametags can only be replaced if the mod is installed on the client, otherwise the name is changed everywhere else.
- Players will not be required to relog for changes

asielib:
AsieLib (with fixed Bleeding Pipe vulnerability)

This repository is a fork of AsieLib for Minecraft 1.7.10 containing an important security vulnerability fix and a few other improvements.

 Security vulnerability fix in this fork

This fork fixes the serious Bleeding Pipe vulnerability (only for this mod itself, not for others - many mods are affected!) by simply removing the affected method, only leaving an error message explaining that.

This means it might break mods that use the affected Base64 decodeToObject method. However, to my knowledge, at least none of asie's popular mods utilize it.

 Please make sure that you're not affected through other mods. A good start is to also install the serializationisbad mod and/or check out their list of affected mods.

If AsieLib is the only affected mod that you're using, switching to this fork should suffice.

 Other improvements of this fork

 Features

 Load and save mod settings from a JSON file
 Automatically creates a default config file if none exists
 Detects when the config file is edited on disk and reloads it without restarting
 Backs up broken/corrupted config files with a timestamp before resetting to defaults
 Look up items, blocks, and entities by their in-game I
 Caches registry lookups so repeated lookups don't slow things down
 Match items by their NBT data (enchantments, custom names, written book authors, etc.)
 Partial NBT matching — only the tags you specify need to match, the rest are ignored
 Exact NBT matching — the item must have exactly the tags specified, nothing more
 List NBT matching — check if an item has at least one of the specified enchantment

coordinated-command-blocks:
Coordinated Command Blocks

Adds a button to convert between Relative and Absolute coordinates in Command Blocks

for instance a command block at 10, 10, 10 with setblock ~1 ~2 ~3 stone would convert into setblock 11 12 13 stone , then clicking it again would turn the coords back into ~1 ~2 ~3 

coordinate conversions are always relative to the position of the command block, so it may have unintended consequences when doing execute positioned or execute at , likewise parameters for the particle command might be interpreted as coordinates (as well as anything else "coordinatey" like text in nbt data might be)

ViCeR will only work with multiplayer on 2.2.0+!!!

 What is ViCeR?

ViCeR adds a VHS style overlay when playing but also locks the player into first-person while in survival.

It also adds a command to customise ViCeR:

/vcrc 
 - locked's suboption is a boolean to toggle the locking in first person feature.

vo-speedometer:
⚡ Speedometer

 Player Speed but blocks per second. 

 Active Version Policy: I build 1 JAR for 1 Version . Each release is built specifically for a single Minecraft version anchor. Please make sure you download the matching JAR file for your game version.

Every Minecraft player knows the frustration: you press F3, look for your speed, and vanilla gives you 0.215 blocks/tick . A raw physics calculation unit that means nothing during normal gameplay. Is that fast? Is that slow? How fast are you actually flying with Elytra or riding a horse?

 Speedometer fixes this foundation. It converts your movement into real-world readable blocks per second (b/s) . Powered directly by vanilla's 20 TPS physics engine, it updates dynamically, breaks down horizontal vs vertical velocity, works on mounts and vehicles, and seamlessly consolidates with vanilla's player speed on modern Minecraft versions.

Put a player head on an armor stand and it'll look like that player. The mod uses the skin's slim or wide model, hides the head item, and keeps the stand's pose. Poses made with Armor Poser work too, and armor on the stand renders over the skin.

 How to use 

Place an armor stand and put a player head on it. That's it.

A stand left in the vanilla rest pose uses the same standing idle as a player; custom poses stay frozen.

 Settings 

With Armor Poser installed, the controls are in its stand screen. Without it, sneak and use the stand to open a small settings screen.

- Head Skin turns the player appearance off if you want the wooden stand back.
- Cape is off by default. It shows whatever cape the player is wearing, from Mojang or most cape mods. An elytra hides the cape and only uses the cape texture while this is on.

WHAT DID IT DO 
It adds support for motion NBT to the world, which makes your mini-game maps easier to make.

 HOW TO USE IT 
Add tag to what entity that you want to move.

here are all the available tags:

-"mot" : Throws entities in the direction of your gaze

-"random mot","random mot mid","random mot big" :Throws entities in the direction of your gaze, but adds randomness

-"one random mot" : Add randomly but it doesn't work when applied to multiple entities

-"random exp" : throws entities to a random direction, if you do this to multiple entities at once, then it will look like an explosion!

-"trace": Throw entities to the nearest player

-"away": Throw entities away from the nearest player

Here's an example of throwing a snowball:

/summon snowball ~ ~ ~ {Tags:["random mot"]}

它做了什么 它为世界添加了对运动NBT的支持，这使得您的迷你游戏地图更容易制作。 如何使用它 将标记添加到要移动的实体。 这里是所有可用的标签： - “mot”：将实体扔向你凝视的方向 - “random mot”，“random mot mid”，“random mot big”：向你注视的方向投掷实体，但增加随机性 - “one random mot”：随机添加，但应用于多个实体时不起作用 - “random exp”：将实体随机抛向一个方向，如果你一次对多个实体这样做，那么它看起来就像一个爆炸！ - “trace”：将实体扔给最近的玩家 - “away”：将实体从最近的玩家处扔开 下面是一个扔雪球的例子： /summon snowball ~ {Tags：[“random mot”]}

no-moon-no-problem:
The Necroturgy ritual from Goety requires sculk blocks, non-wooden slabs, flower pots, and darkness. A logical restriction, yes. Except that darkness means nighttime darkness specifically, and the ritual cannot be performed in dimensions with no skylight.

This mod is a simple mixin which changes that check to be true if the skylight is below a certain value OR if the dimension doesn't have skylight. Nether and Ender necromancers for the win.

Yes, I did basically learn Minecraft modding for the express purpose of fixing this one issue I had with Goety. And yes, I know I could've just built a necroturgic altar setup in the Overworld, but I could accept that for the Sky or Storm ritual types. The fact Goety doesn't let you summon undead servants in the dimension filled with skeletons and zombified piglins specifically felt like it needed fixing.

lplanperm:
LanPerm —— 轻量级局域网权限管理

 LanPerm 是一个简单但强大的 Minecraft 权限控制模组，专为局域网（LAN）联机或小型服务器设计。它允许房主或管理员无需修改任何配置文件，直接在游戏内对特定玩家进行细粒度的权限禁止与恢复。

无论你是想防止朋友不小心破坏建筑、误用指令，还是希望创建一个更有序的联机环境，LanPerm 都能在几秒钟内完成设置。

 ✨ 主要特性
- 无需重启 ：指令实时生效，即输即用。
- 权限细分 ：独立控制 7 类行为，互不干扰。
- 批量操作 ：一键禁止/恢复某玩家的全部权限。
- 状态查询 ：随时查看某玩家的权限受限情况。
- 极简设计 ：纯指令交互，无 GUI，无额外依赖。

 📋 指令一览

 指令 说明 
 ------ ------ 
 /lanperm deny 禁止该玩家的某个权限 
 /lanperm deny all 禁止该玩家的所有权限 
 /lanperm allow 恢复该玩家的某个权限 
 /lanperm allow all 恢复该玩家的所有权限 
 /lanperm check 查看该玩家的权限状态 
 /lanperm list 列出所有被限制过权限的玩家 
 /lanperm help 显示帮助信息 

 🛡️ 可控权限类型

 权限 对应行为 
 ------ ---------- 
 BUILD 放置 / 破坏方块 
 INTERACT 与箱子、门、按钮、拉杆等交互 
 ATTACK 攻击任何实体（生物、玩家等） 
 CHAT 发送聊天消息（可配合聊天事件扩展） 
 COMMAND 使用任何指令 
 DROP 从物品栏丢弃物品 
 PICKUP 拾取掉落的物品 

 🎯 适用场景
- 与朋友联机时，临时禁止某人的 破坏权限 ，避免熊孩子炸房子。
- 只允许特定玩家 使用指令 ，防止其他人滥用 /gamemode 等。
- 禁止玩家 攻击宠物 或 拾取战利品 ，实现更公平的冒险。
- 快速 测试 时，一键禁止所有权限，让玩家只能旁观。

 📦 安装与兼容

Better Totem upgrades the Totem of Undying with an intelligent survival system that detects how you are dying and applies specific effects to save you. It can grant fire resistance, water breathing, regeneration, resistance, speed, and even automatically rescue you from the void with safe teleportation.
The mod also includes hostile mob knockback, automatic destruction of dangerous falling blocks like gravel or anvils, and support for using totems directly from the inventory. Everything is configurable through a JSON config file. The main goal is to prevent unfair Hardcore deaths without breaking the vanilla experience.

climate-based-growth:
Climate Based Growth 

This mod makes plant growth dependent on biome temperature. Instead of plants growing at the same speed everywhere, they now have a preferred climate.

 How it works: 
 Optimal Temperature: If a plant is in its favorite climate (e.g., Cactus in a Desert or Spruce in a Snowy Taiga), it grows slightly faster than vanilla.
 Poor Climate: If a plant is in a climate it doesn't like, growth is significantly slowed down.
 Gaussian Scaling: The growth speed scales smoothly. The further the temperature is from the plant's "sweet spot," the slower it grows.

 Supported Plants: 
 Crops: Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Beetroots, Torchflowers, Pitcher Plants.
 Trees: All vanilla saplings, including Mangrove and Cherry.
 Others: Sugar Cane, Cactus, Bamboo, Cocoa, Sweet Berries, Kelp, and Sea Pickles.
 Nether/End: Nether Wart, Fungi, and Chorus Flowers.

 Technical: 
 Server-Side Only

基于气候的增长 这种模式使得植物的生长依赖于生物群系的温度。而不是植物生长在相同的速度无处不在，他们现在有一个首选的气候。 工作原理： 最佳温度：如果一种植物在它最喜欢的气候中（例如，沙漠中的仙人掌或雪中的云杉），它的生长速度略快于原版。 恶劣的气候：如果植物处于它不喜欢的气候中，生长就会明显减慢。 高斯缩放：生长速度平滑缩放。温度离植物的“甜蜜点”越远，它生长得越慢。 支持的工厂： 农作物：小麦，胡萝卜，土豆，甜菜根，火炬花，猪笼草。 树木：所有原版树苗，包括红树林和樱桃。 其他：甘蔗，仙人掌，竹子，可可，甜浆果，海带，海菜。 虚空/结束：虚空疣，真菌，合唱花。 技术人员： 仅服务器端

The vilmiComfort build is designed for those who want to transform Minecraft — make it bigger, more beautiful, and deeper. While I originally created this build for myself, I’d be happy to hear your constructive feedback and suggestions for improvement!

For lovers of beautiful graphics who are willing to sacrifice some of their productivity for visual immersion.
For experimenters who are ready to test beta versions.

no-z-fighting:
What is Z-fighting?
Z-fighting is when 2 faces of a block, item, entity etc. are on similar or the same coordinates. The game doesn't know which one to render over the other so it attempts to render both at the same time which makes the textures clip through each other, producing a flickering effect that looks bad and can even strain the eyes if it's intense. Some models and textures either have not accounted for z-fighting or haven't separated the faces far enough. This pack fixes a ton of these issues with mainly model files and a few texture files.

---
 Most of the entity fixes require OptiFine or EMF.

I cannot guarantee compatibility with other packs but it should be compatible with most vanilla edit packs.
This pack should be put under other packs to avoid compatibility issues

---
 Fixes 
- Iron bars with ground and ceiling 
- Piglin and zombified piglins' legs 
- Cat tail and bo

什么是Z-战斗？ Z-战斗是当一个方块，项目，实体等的两个面在相似或相同的坐标。游戏不知道哪个渲染在另一个，所以它试图在同一时间渲染，使材质剪辑通过对方，产生闪烁的效果，看起来很糟糕，如果强烈的话甚至会让眼睛疲劳。战斗或者没有把脸分开的足够远。这个包主要用模型文件和一些材质文件修复了大量的这些问题。 --- 大多数实体修复都需要OptiFine或EMF。 我不能保证与其他包的兼容性，但它应该与大多数原版编辑包兼容。 应将此软件包放在其他软件包之下，以避免兼容性问题 --- 修复 - 带地、顶棚的铁条 - 猪和僵尸猪的腿 - 猫尾巴和bo

Overview
 

The British Rail Class 390 "Pendolino" is an electric high-speed tilting train that has run on the West Coast Main Line since July 2002, currently operated by Avanti West Coast (previously Virgin Trains) and leased from Angel Trains. Built by Alstom using Fiat Ferroviaria's Pendolino tilting technology, the fleet was originally assembled in nine-car formation at Alstom's Washwood Heath plant in Birmingham, with 31 units later extended to eleven cars using additional carriages built in Savigliano, Italy, and four brand-new eleven-car units built there directly. 

Each carriage tilts up to 8° using electromechanical actuators, sensed and triggered automatically by onboard equipment ahead of each curve, letting the train run curves around 20% faster than it otherwise could without discomfort to passengers — even the pantograph tilts in the opposite direction to keep contact with

This resource pack gives Bedwars a unique frozen and icy atmosphere while keeping the original Minecraft style recognizable. The goal of this pack is not to make gameplay easier or give any kind of PvP advantage, but simply to create a cool visual theme that feels fresh and fun to play with. Most items and weapons have been redesigned with an icy look, giving them a frosted, chilled, or crystal‑like appearance. This creates a consistent theme across the pack without changing how the game actually plays.

Blocks, on the other hand, are not frozen or heavily stylized. Instead, they are made cleaner and slightly more polished so they fit well with the icy items without becoming distracting. Wool colors stay clear and easy to recognize, which is important for Bedwars, but they still blend nicely with the overall cold aesthetic. The combination of clean blocks and frozen items creates a balan

这个资源包给了Bedwars一个独特的冰冻和冰冷的氛围，同时保持了原始的《我的世界》风格。这个包的目标不是让游戏更容易玩，也不是给任何一种PVP优势，而是简单地创造一个很酷的视觉主题，感觉新鲜和有趣的游戏。大多数物品和武器都被重新设计成冰冷的外观，给他们一个磨砂，冰镇，或水晶般的外观。这创造了一个一致的主题，整个包没有改变游戏的实际发挥。 另一方面，方块状物并没有被冻结或过度风格化。相反，它们被做得更干净，稍微抛光一些，这样它们就可以很好地与冰冷的物品搭配，而不会让人分心。羊毛颜色保持清晰，容易辨认，这对Bedwars很重要，但它们仍然很好地与整体冰冷的审美融合在一起。干净的方块状物和冻结的物品的结合创造了一种平衡

animetro:
A lightweight cel-shaded look with subtle retro display artifacts. 

 

This shader focuses on stylizing Minecraft's default rendering through a simple post-processing pipeline rather than replacing the game's lighting model. Colors are quantized into discrete brightness bands, outlines are generated from screen-space color differences, and subtle CRT-inspired effects are applied to create a clean cartoon-like presentation while preserving vanilla readability.

 

 

---

 Cel-Shaded Color Quantization. 
The final image is processed into distinct brightness bands using luminance-based quantization. Instead of smooth tonal gradients, surfaces transition between defined lighting levels, giving terrain, structures, and entities a hand-drawn or animated appearance.

NeoLux

Warm, low sunlight against quiet shade, soft volumetric clouds and dark water that mirrors the shore. A deferred shaderpack for Iris that goes for a calm, cinematic look rather than a long list of effects.

---

What makes a shaderpack look good is mostly the light, not the effect list. NeoLux runs the overworld on a palette of its own that follows the height of the sun. At noon the dome is a deep blue over a pale horizon. Towards evening the light turns warm and low, spreads out around the sun, and the rest of the sky goes grey and still.

The sun is strong and the shade is weak, and the shade loses part of its color. A sunlit wall and its shaded side read as two different things instead of the same surface in a bluer tint, and a field of flowers keeps its color where the sun actually hits it.

jobsreborn-patchplacebreak:
JobsReborn-PatchPlaceBreak [Addon]

A place-and-break patch extension of JobsReborn.

 Place-and-break issue

With JobsReborn, it appears that placing a block and then breaking it is counted as a valid job
action which leads to a payment for the player.
Given this fact, it's straightforward to imagine a diamond ore being gathered with a Silk Touch
pickaxe and immediately after being replaced again so that the process can be repeated
indefinitely...

A solution with JobsReborn is to remove money and xp when a diamond ore is placed, preventing
the previously described scenario. But it isn't perfect: if you expect to use money and xp boost
for whatever reason, the amount of money to give when the block is broken will be higher than
the amount to be retrieved when placing the same one. And... well... losing money and xp when you
place a block for decoration isn't very appreciated by players

client-guard:
ClientGuard

ClientGuard detects and removes players running blacklisted client-side mods. The detection is designed to be quick and mostly silent.

Ships with tested probes for Wurst, Meteor Client, Freecam, Baritone, XRay Mod, and PlayerESP. Additional probes can be added at any time via config or the /cg probe command.

---

 How It Works

Every cheat client registers its keybindings under unique translation keys (e.g. key.wurst.zoom ). When a player joins, ClientGuard silently places a hidden sign below them packed with those keys as translatable components, opens the sign editor on the client, and immediately closes it. The client echoes the sign back to the server — if any keys were resolved to readable labels (e.g. Zoom ), the mod is present.

The entire exchange happens on the loading screen. Players only see a sign editor for a split second.

---

 Features

- Warn system — opti

客户卫士 ClientGuard检测并删除运行黑名单客户端模组的玩家。检测的目的是快速和大多数沉默。 随附Wurst、Meteor Client、Freecam、Baritone、XRay 模组和PlayerESP的测试探头。可以随时通过config或/cg probe命令添加其他探头。 --- 它是如何工作 每一个作弊客户端都在唯一的翻译键下注册它的键绑定（例如key.wurst.zoom）。当玩家加入时，ClientGuard会在它们下面悄悄地放置一个隐藏的符号，这些符号与这些键一起打包为可翻译的组件，打开客户端上的符号编辑器，然后立即关闭它。客户端将符号回显到服务器-如果任何键被解析为可读标签（例如Zoom），模组就存在。 整个交换发生在加载屏幕上。玩家只看到一个符号编辑器的一瞬间。 --- 特征 - 警告系统-可选
